*D e s c r i p t i o n*
Amvoidla Reegla, the halfwudgie traveled from lands afar. Selectively bred short purple fur, bright green eyes, and a grey mane of quills make for a striking appearance. They don't like to show off though, and often cover themselves to hide their peculiar skin tone. She wears hooded clothing and tries to not accentuate her skin tone.

*I n t r o d u c t i o n*
Amvoidla took a deep breath, and kneeled in front of her workbench. Another sword, enchanted for battle to help someone retain their edge. She felt the elegent curve slowly attune to her force, the imperfections healing, a gentle coating causing the blade to sharpen instantly with her magical force. She picks up the sword, and slices through a leathered hide to show it's improved blade.

"Amazing! Even the grind-wheel couldn't get it that sharp! How do you do that?" The fascinated sellsword had a brief glint in his eye, before his mind returned to the task at hand. "Thank you, I've sent the rest of your payment to your sister as requested."

Amvoidla turned towards him and looked in his eyes. Then with an intense stare, studied his gear. A loosly fit leather breastplate, some roughly hammered greaves. And no gloves. Not a repeat customer. "This should cut through the carrion crawler's carapace with ease. Make sure to not make much noise, it could be worth not wearing those boots. They secrete acid, the metal will melt in an instant. Good luck on your hunt." 
It was the only advice she could give the young man.

Two days later, she felt the enchantment fade. The sword had been broken, the sellsword was dead or had lost 50 gp. Saying her prayers for the day, she offered his soul to the gods. The trek to Empire City was a long one, but his payment should be enough to get her there. Whether or not she can get work once in the city has yet to be seen, but at least she can leave behind the wretched memories in this place. Amvoidla gave a hopeful prayer for her sister, rose, and set off.

It has been many years since Evelyn Willow became stranded in the Material Plane. After being separated from her family in the Feywild, Evelyn lived a life of seclusion in a forest. Her long search has led her here, to Empire City.

Spending time in the Noir can cause you to lose color.
Losing A color has a specific effect on your character. You cannot regain color with out spending the night outside in Hampstead proper.

1. **Losing Red** ensures that you cannot heal  past 50% of your total hp.
2.**Losing Blue** causes you begin petrifying into black and white marble.  Attack rolls against you have advantage.
The creature automatically fails Strength and Dexterity Saving Throws.
The creature has Resistance to all damage.
The creature is immune to poison and disease, although a poison or disease already in its system is suspended, not neutralized.
3.**Losing Green**
Causes you to begin shaking and fumbling.
When you miss on an attack:, you drop your weapon or item in your hand. This includes component pouches and arcane focuses. When in combat, you start every round prone. It will cost you half movement to stand. At the end of your turn you will once again fall prone.
4.**Losing Yellow.**
Causes your body to begin sweating.
The creature is overcome with fever and cannot take bonus actions or reactions.
It has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws and checks and attack rolls that use either ability.
